legacy_compatibility.description: Existing test suite remains green and legacy contracts remain importable

known_limitations: The spectral lookup provider uses supplied table values and does not implement physical spectroscopy or radiation
The ray-transfer contract remains interface-only and has no provider
The prescribed visual provider supports explicit geometry only and performs no frame transformation
The visual preview is a local optional-dependency render and not a browser application
The signature lookup is axisymmetric in direction cosine and has no azimuthal dependence
Transport adapters and external service endpoints are not included in this tranche
The validity envelope is a declared numerical/study boundary, not an external accuracy certification
Finite near-vacuum cases may be reported outside because the low-order straight solver cannot construct finite zones
Signature pressure metadata binds an asset to an operating point; it is not pressure interpolation or physical radiation prediction
Time-sliced signature assets are prescribed tabulated lookup data; the low-ambient-pressure fixture is not a rarefied/atomistic transport model
The analytical visual provider is a low-order first-cell engineering approximation; its marginal construction-boundary result is not a conservative plume boundary
The first-MVP pressure fixtures correct classification using static exit pressure while preserving legacy total-pressure examples as regression-only anchors
